backend/main.mo: Motoko canister handling user profiles with authorization plus storage and queries for contact inquiries and fire extinguisher certificates.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing updated contact email changes across frontend files with component and test metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing purpose and content of all major frontend files including pages, components, hooks, and SEO config.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind setup defining OKLCH‑based color variables and theme tokens for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell loading the React app entrypoint.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures TanStack Router with all site, certificate, and admin routes wrapped in the main layout.
Protects admin pages by enforcing login and admin checks, showing login prompts or access-denied UI as needed.
frontend/src/components/admin/DownloadCe: Button that triggers PDF generation for a certificate and shows loading state.
frontend/src/components/BrandLogo.tsx: Renders the company logo image with configurable size.
frontend/src/components/CertificateDetai: Displays full certificate details with validity status, client/service info, QR code, and technical fields.
frontend/src/components/CtaBar.tsx: CTA bar component offering phone, email, and quote links with default and compact variants.
frontend/src/components/QrCode.tsx: Canvas-based QR code renderer that draws a generated QR image for a given value.
frontend/src/components/ServiceIcon.tsx: Extracts and displays an individual service icon from a sprite grid using cropping and scaling.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer component showing company info, navigation links, services list, and contact details with a bottom copyright bar.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Responsive header with logo, navigation, admin link handling, call-to-action buttons, and a mobile menu sheet.
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper rendering header, main outlet, and footer for all pages.
frontend/src/content/routes.ts: Defines navigation link paths, labels, and admin-only visibility flags.
frontend/src/content/seoMeta.ts: Provides SEO titles and descriptions for main site pages.
frontend/src/content/siteContent.ts: Contains static site content including hero text, about info, services, and product listings.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCertificates.ts: React-query hooks for fetching, creating, and updating fire extinguisher certificates via an actor API.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity context and provider for authentication using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/usePageMeta.ts: Hook that updates the document title and meta description when invoked.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React-query hooks for retrieving and submitting contact inquiries through the actor API.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining light/dark themes and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point initializing React, query client, and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with company info, core values, and marketing content.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminCertificat: Form page for creating or editing fire extinguisher certificates, loading existing data and submitting create/update mutations.
Displays a sortable table of all certificates with status, actions, and navigation to create or edit entries.
frontend/src/pages/CertificateVerificati: Page that loads and displays a certificate by token, showing errors or loading states as needed.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Contact form page with validation and inquiry submission via useSubmitInquiry.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the homepage with a hero section, trust indicators, a services preview, and uses site content and meta hooks.
frontend/src/pages/IndustriesPage.tsx: Displays an industries overview with icons, descriptions, and industry‑specific fire safety solutions.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Shows fire extinguisher products and expandable lists of additional fire safety equipment using accordions.
frontend/src/pages/ProjectsPage.tsx: Presents completed fire safety projects with icons and descriptions plus a section outlining project capabilities.
frontend/src/pages/ServicesPage.tsx: Lists all offered fire safety services with icons and descriptions and includes a step‑by‑step service process section.
frontend/src/utils/certificates.ts: Utility functions for formatting dates, checking expiry, and parsing date strings.
frontend/src/utils/origin.ts: Utilities to get the current origin and build certificate verification URLs.
frontend/src/utils/pdf/certificatePdf.ts: Generates a styled certificate PDF using canvas, including sections, QR code, and formatting helpers.
frontend/src/utils/qr.ts: Lightweight QR generator that builds a matrix and renders it to a canvas as a data URL.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and managing hash-based params.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending theme colors, animations, and container settings with plugins.
project_state.json: Defines overall project metadata, architecture notes, known issues, and current features for an ICP full‑stack fire‑safety certificate system. Includes planned certificate/QR/PDF features, admin restrictions, and generated image assets.
